message.reasoning: We need to respond. The user wants to book a flight from San Francisco to Los Angeles for next month November, two days after close of the 14th day in the year 2026. That means after 14th day of year 2026? The 14th day of the year is January 14? Actually day 14 of year 2026 is Jan 14. Two days after close of the 14th day would be Jan 16? But they say next month November. There's confusion. They want flight in November. Maybe they mean after the 14th day of November? The 14th day of November is Nov 14. Two days after close of the 14th day would be Nov 16. So flight on Nov 16, 2026. Business class. Payment via AMEX card id 'AMEX123456789'. Access token 'abc123xyz'. Need to check if enough money: user has around $8000. We need to compute flight cost. Use get_flight_cost with travel_from: San Francisco (airport code: SFO), travel_to: Los Angeles (LAX), travel_date: 2026-11-16, travel_class: business. Then check balance of card. Use get_credit_card_balance with card_id: AMEX123456789. Compare cost <= 8000. If yes, proceed to book_flight. Also maybe need to verify traveler info? Not necessary. We'll just do get_flight_cost, get_credit_card_balance, then book_flight. Let's do that.
